story_text: As a user, I want deleting a non-existent task to return a clear error so that I know the operation failed.

positive.title: Delete a task with a valid-format but non-existent ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a valid-format ID that does not exist in the system.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: 404 Not Found · error body includes descriptive message

negative.title: Delete with non-numeric ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a non-numeric ID (e.g., 'abc').
2. Observe the response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

negative.title: Error response body schema on failed delete
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a valid-format ID that does not exist in the system.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

edge.title: Delete with null ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a null ID.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

edge.title: Delete with 0 = ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with an ID of 0.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

edge.title: Delete with SQL injection in the ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a malicious SQL injection payload in the ID.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

edge.title: Delete with negative ID
steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /tasks/{id} with a negative ID.
2. Observe the response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message
